title: Aluminum electrode-based electrocoagulation for efficient Pb2+ ion and TOC removal from industrial effluent: performance to techno-economic analysis
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01074H, Paper
Gowthaman Somasundaram, Selvaraju Thangavelu
Electrocoagulation using aluminium electrodes generates Al3+ and OH− ions, forming in situ Al(OH)3 flocs. These flocs effectively adsorb and remove the industrial wastewater with Pb2+ ions and organic pollutants.
